description.zh:
数据库ID，可通过调用接口[ListDatabases](~~141873~~)获取物理库ID的值，调用接口[ListLogicDatabases](~~141874~~)获取逻辑库ID的值。
>DatabaseId的值即为DbId的值。
description.en:
The database ID. You can call the [ListDatabases](~~141873~~) operation to query the ID of a physical database and the [ListLogicDatabases](~~141874~~) operation to query the ID of a logical database.

>  The value of DatabaseId is that of DbId.

description.zh:
是否逻辑库，取值：
- true：逻辑库
- false：物理库
description.en:
Specifies whether the database is a logical database. Valid values:

*   true: Logical database.
*   false: Physical database.

The type of the permission to be verified.

Valid values:

*   QUERY
*   EXPORT
*   CORRECT
*   LOGIN
*   PERF

description.zh:
租户ID。
> 取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见[查看租户信息](~~181330~~)。
description.en:
The ID of the tenant.

>  View Tenant ID by hovering over your profile icon in the DMS console. For more information, see the [View information about the current tenant](~~181330~~) section of the "Manage DMS tenants" topic.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dms-enterprise check-batch-table-access-permission --table-name-list test_name --db-id 43 --logic false --permission-type QUERY --tid 3000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dms-enterprise CheckBatchTableAccessPermission --region cn-hangzhou --TableNameList '["test_name"]' --PermissionType QUERY --DbId 43 --Logic false --Tid 3000
